puzzle.hint: A powerful opening call to taqwa (God-consciousness) and a warning about the terrifying Day of Judgment at the start of Surah Al-Hajj.
puzzle.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ شَىْءٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
puzzle.verseEn: O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed, the convulsion of the [final] Hour is a terrible thing.
